Northbridge Institute of Technology — admissions office · how to apply

Financial aid

Types of aid

Northbridge awards need-based financial aid. We meet the full demonstrated need of every admitted undergraduate.

Applying for aid

Submit the CSS Profile. International students are eligible for need-based financial aid on the same basis as domestic students.

Where to send documents

Aid documents are processed by Northbridge Student Financial Services, and federal forms are filed at the federal aid site.

Scholarships

There are no merit scholarships at Northbridge; every award is need-based.
